description: This Java class serves as a base class for integration tests within a Spring Boot application, setting up a PostgreSQL container for testing purposes, configuring environment variables, and defining dynamic properties for testing.

classes.name: IntegrationTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for setting up integration tests with an embedded PostgreSQL database and dynamic property configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the PostgreSQL container before all tests and checks environment variable to determine whether to run Docker-based tests.

methods.name: registerPg
methods.description: Registers dynamic properties such as database URL, username, password, and JWT configuration for the testing environment.
